tool_input.command: ls ~/.claude-mem 2>/dev/null; f=$(ls ~/.claude-mem/*.db 2>/dev/null | head -1); echo $f; [ -n "$f" ] && sqlite3 "$f" "select id,created_at,prompt_text from user_prompts order by id desc limit 3" 2>&1 | head -20

mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/internal-http.md <<'EOF'
# Plain HTTP for internal hosts

The project's current recorded decision is to enforce HTTPS everywhere, with no plaintext exception, so internal hosts are not permitted to use plain HTTP.
EOF
cat docs/policies/internal-http.md
